title: Alpaca Launches Live Trading for Index Options via Trading API
summary: Start trading index options live on Alpaca through the Trading API and dashboard. Access SPX, VIX, XSP, and more for your strategies.
body_markdown:
A few weeks ago we shared that index options were available in[paper trading via Alpaca's Trading API](https://alpaca.markets/blog/alpaca-introduces-index-options-paper-trading/) . Today, index options are available for live trading through the our Trading API and dashboard! Available indexes include SPX, SPXW, VIX, VIXW, DJX, and XSP, with more coming soon.


We’ve long focused on API-first infrastructure for builders. We’ve extended that coverage to index options, so you can test strategies, confirm order handling, and validate expiration logic in paper before trading live.


## **How Index Options Work on Alpaca**


The index options workflow includes a few key differences:


- **Cash Settlement** : Profit or loss settles in cash, so you do not take delivery of shares or hold a position after expiration.
- **No Early Assignment** : European-style exercise means a position cannot be assigned before expiration, and you can’t early exercise long positions.
- **Tax Considerations:** Certain broad-based index options may receive Section 1256 tax treatment, under which gains and losses generally receive 60% long-term and 40% short-term capital gain or loss treatment, regardless of holding period **.***


## **Risks and Considerations**


Options trading is not suitable for all investors and can result in significant losses. A few points are specific to index options and to this release:


- **Paper results differ from live** : Paper trading is a simulated environment. Fills, liquidity, latency, and order handling can differ from live trading.
- **AM settlement timing** : AM-settled contracts reference a value published after the open, so the final settlement value is not known at the close of the prior session.
- **Order cutoffs** : AM-settled contracts may have a morning cutoff for new orders on expiration day.
- **Market data availability:** Alpaca does not currently provide index data through its Market Data offering. Support for index market data is planned for a future release.
- **Exchange fees** : Index options carry exchange fees that differ from standard equity options. Review[current pricing](https://files.alpaca.markets/disclosures/library/BrokFeeSched.pdf?ref=alpaca.markets) before trading live.
- **Commissions** : US-listed index options trades are subject to a $0.50 per contract fee in addition to the pass-through regulatory and exchange fees mentioned above.


## **Get Started with Index Options**


To get started with index options,[sign in to your account](https://app.alpaca.markets/account/login?ref=alpaca.markets) and read our step-by-step guide on[how to trade equity and index options with Alpaca.](https://alpaca.markets/learn/how-to-trade-options-with-alpaca?ref=alpaca.markets)


Still have questions? Learn more in the[docs](https://docs.alpaca.markets/us/docs/options-trading?ref=alpaca.markets) or contact us at[\[email protected\]](https://alpaca.markets/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#a9dadcd9d9c6dbdde9c8c5d9c8cac887c4c8dbc2ccddda) .
